Permanent, Part Time (0.63 FTE)

Excellent staff benefits

Friendly and supportive team environment with opportunity for professional development

About Auburn House

A Place for compassion: Auburn House is an aged care provider and specialist aged person's mental health unit with 30 private rooms in a newly refurbished home like environment. We care for residents with diverse mental health, behavioural and psychological needs. Our care model is centred around the person, ensuring their ability to make choices in every aspect of their lives is supported. We strive for care that is provided in consultation with each person, eliminating institutional elements to the greatest extent possible.

We are a vital part of St Vincent's Hospital Melbourne Residential, Continuing Care Health Services, a key clinical service program of SVHM and broader SVHA Public Hospital division. Auburn House operates with a qualified nursing workforce of Enrolled and Registered nurses with agreed workforce ratios and staffing levels that exceed industry standard.

About the Role

Join us in transforming lives. As a Registered Nurse at Auburn House in Hawthorn East, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing the dignity and quality of life of our residents with unique behavioural and psychological needs. Here, within a nurturing and safe environment, you'll have the exceptional opportunity to hone your skills providing clinical care and therapeutic engagement to a diverse group of residents, making a profound impact on their lives.

Unleash your potential. We are committed to your professional growth. You will be part of an incredible team that supports and challenges you to be your best. As you provide care in this challenging yet rewarding environment, you will evolve both personally and professionally.

Classifications for this position will range from Registered Psychiatric Nurse Grade 2 NP21 - NP70.

About You

Empathy and Expertise: We are seeking a suitably qualified and experienced Registered Nurse with a background in aged mental health or dementia care. Your unwavering commitment to a person-centred approach to care will empower residents to achieve their health goals and enhance their overall well-being. With a positive work attitude and engaging manner, you will thrive on the unique and varied needs of our resident population, striving to provide the highest standard of evidence-based care.

Qualification and Commitment: in addition to your experience, you will need:

Current Nursing Registration with the Nursing & Midwifery Board of Australia via AHPRA

An understanding of relevant legislation; principles and practice of aged psychiatry, and an understanding of the Commonwealth Strengthened Aged Care Standards

Current NDIS Worker Screening Check, or be willing to obtain.

What We Offer

We prioritize your wellbeing with regular events and programs designed to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Ability to join Fitness Passport - Your access pass to a wide range of fitness facilities. We believe a healthy body supports a healthy mind.

Salary Packaging - Increase your take home pay!

Access to exclusive discounts and promotions through our Foundation.

We are dedicated to your professional development, offering regular opportunities to help reach your career goals.

A culture of continuous improvement, where your contributions make a difference

Fixed Term 0.35 FTE Postgraduate Fellow

Department of Gastroenterology & Hepatology - Endoscopy

APPLY HERE

Applications are invited from suitably qualified medical practitioners for the above position in the Western Sydney Local Health District.The position will be primarily located at Westmead Hospital within the Department of Gastroenterology & Hepatology (Endoscopy Services).

The Department of Gastroenterology & Hepatology at Westmead Hospital provides access to a full range of gastroenterological services including inpatient and outpatient care, standard and advanced interventional endoscopy, EUS and ERCP. Clinical duties will involve initiating and developing all aspects of relevant research projects, attend endoscopy sessions and interview patients or study participants.

Successful applicants will be continuing the current clinical endoscopic programs focusing on: (a) endoscopic ultrasound (EUS), (b) capsule endoscopy, (c) methods to improve safety and efficacy of endoscopic resection in the colon, stomach and oesophagus for early cancer and pre-cancer, (d) techniques to minimize the occurrence of ERCP complications and enhance technical efficacy and (e) methods in the endoscopic palliation of malignancy.

The position will be for a period of twelve months for the 2027 Clinical Year from 1 February 2027 to 30 January 2028

Applicants must have Australian Fellowship-Specialist Registration

Successful applicants may be offered a conjoint university appointment within the Faculty of Medicine at the relevant University attached to each facility. The level of academic appointment will be commensurate with the qualifications, experience and scholarship and will be held only during the tenure of the Western Sydney Local Health District appointment. No remuneration is attached to the University appointment. The appointee will be responsible to the University for academic matters and to the district for clinical matters.

Appointees may be eligible for credentialing and privileging across all other facilities in the Western Sydney Local Health District.

Conditions of appointment are in accordance with the Staff Specialists (State) Award

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
Selection Criteria

1.Possess registration with the Medical Board of Australia and Fellowship of the Royal Australian College of Physicians or equivalent as provided for in the Staff Specialists (State) Award. Must have Australian Citizenship, Permanent Australian Residency or Special Category Visa.

2.Sound clinical knowledge in clinical trials, general and interventional endoscopy, endoscopicultrasound and gastroenterology demonstrated through successful clinical practice in an environment appropriate to the requirements of the position.

3.Demonstrated skills and attitudes appropriate for practice as a Senior Medical -Dental Practitioner including:

oHigh level interpersonal and communication skills.

oDemonstrated ability working within a multidisciplinary team.

oExperience and involvement in quality assurance activities and evidence-based best practice.

oDemonstrated commitment to teaching and supervision

4.Familiarity with research concepts and commitment to support basic, applied or clinical research within the Department.Completion of a previous higher research degree or a history of published research in high impact peer reviewed journals is desirable.

5.Sound clinical knowledge in clinical research and clinical trials, including : (A) Management of electronic databases (e.g- FileMaker, RedCAP, MS Access); (B) Performing statistical analysis, including working with statistical software (e.g-SPSS, Stata, SAS); (C) Managing interactions with the Human Research Ethics Committee (HREC) - applications, amendments, reporting, etc.; (D) Professional guidance of research support personal (research nurse, research students). (E) Experience with health system data storage, retrieval and analysis

6.Proven experience in Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS) including assessment and sampling (FNA - FNB) of submucosal lesions of the GI tract and pancreatic lesions. ( 100 procedures) is desirable.

7.Proven experience in Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangio-Pancreatography (ERCP) - including but not limited to selective biliary cannulation, selective pancreatic cannulation, treatment of common biliary pathologies such as choledocholithiasis, strictures, etc. ( 100 procedures ) is desirable.

8.Proven experience with tertiary level colonic and oesophageal EMR and other forms of advanced endoscopic tissue resection is desirable. Proven experience in capsule endoscopy reporting is desirable.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

Excellent benefits including salary packaging

Friendly and supportive team environment

Permanent, part time, 0.5 FTE 

About the Role
You will be an experienced, skilled and knowledgeable clinician, with a good understanding of the NDIS system. You will have a minimum of 5 years post qualification clinical experience within mental health, in either Social Work, Occupational Therapy, RPN or Psychology.

Work within the Strengths Model of Recovery orientated practice. Actively uphold a culture of hope by using optimistic language, supporting people and celebrating consumers' recovery efforts.

Undertake the assessment, provision of treatment and delivery of targeted interventions to consumers with complex mental health related needs and their family-carers 

Build and maintain effective partnerships between the mental health teams, including the SVMH NDIS Lead, and the National Disability Insurance Agency (NDIA), Local Area Coordinators (LAC's) and NDIS funded service providers.

Classifications for this position will range from:

OT-SW Grade 4 HR9 - HR12 or HR25 - HR28 ($107,260 - $122,548 per annum pro rata)

Psychologist Grade 3 PL1 - PL4 ($108,279 - $123,905 per annum pro rata)

RPN Grade 4 NP75 - NP77 ($121,274 - $130,603 per annum pro rata)

Your Contribution 

A minimum of 5 years post qualification clinical experience within Mental Health in either SW, OT, Psychology and RPN. 

Registration with Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (all disciplines except Social Work).

Experience in working within or closely with the NDIS sector.

Ability to develop care plans that are creative and flexible, place the consumer at the centre of their care, and which draw in services from across a range of sectors

Demonstrated ability to working collaboratively with clients and carers to promote self-determination and enable progress towards reaching personal goals

A valid Nationally Coordinated Criminal History check, or willing to obtain

What We Offer

A focus on wellbeing initiatives, with regular events and programs

Confidential, solutions-focused employee counselling

A healthy work-life balance encouraged.

Ability to join Fitness Passport - Your pass to an extensive choice of fitness facilities

Salary Packaging - Increase your take home pay!

Discounts always available through our Foundation

Regular opportunities for professional development to assist you to reach your career goals

Culture of continuous improvement

About Complex Care

The SVMH Complex Care Program provides a specialist service for consumers experiencing high levels of complexity, by developing integrated and recovery focused complex care packages in collaboration with the consumer, treating team, services and carers. In conjunction with severe mental illness, these complexities can include recurring homelessness, co-existing substance use issues, cognitive difficulties, challenging or antisocial behaviour or patterns of offending behaviours and associated interaction with the criminal justice system, comorbidities, and high users of services. 

Working at St Vincent's 
St Vincent's Hospital Melbourne (SVHM) is a leading teaching, research and tertiary health service. SVHM provides a diverse range of adult clinical services and is driven by values of Compassion, Justice, Integrity and Excellence.

Please attach your resume and cover letter to your application.

Shortlisting for this position will commence immediately. We encourage you to apply promptly as the advertisement may close early should a suitable applicant be sourced.

We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and abilities. Inclusion is essential to our mission and diversity reflects the community we serve.

As a Triage Delegate with the Statewide Aged Care Assessment Service (ACAS), you will play a vital role in supporting aged clients through the intake and triage process. You will manage incoming referrals, using the Integrated Assessment Tool (IAT) and My Aged Care client records to determine eligibility and clinical priority for a comprehensive assessment.
